name: securekey
description: SecureKey - gestor de contrasenas con cifrado zero-knowledge en el navegador

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @securekey/shared && npm run build --workspace @securekey/api && npm run build:only --workspace @securekey/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @securekey/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @securekey/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace @securekey/api && npm run test --workspace @securekey/web
scripts.test:e2e: docker run --rm --network securekey_edge -e API_URL=http://api:3000/api/v1 securekey/api-dev node apps/api/test/e2e.mjs
scripts.test:http: docker run --rm --network container:securekey-caddy-1 -e NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 -e APP_URL=https://localhost:8443 securekey/api-dev node apps/web/test/http-checks.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:http
scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f api web caddy
